title: radar_episode
description: EchoForge radar_episode document. A single recorded or simulated radar episode produced from a scenario, listing the on-disk product artifacts (range-Doppler maps, IQ, detections, etc.) and the sampling rate used. Conforms to the EchoForge strict-open contract: deterministic ids, explicit provenance, license, and validation envelope.

id.description: Deterministic EchoForge id of the form ef:<kind>:<public_proxy_id>:<16hex>:1, computed from the identity field tuple.

kind.description: Document kind discriminator; must be the literal string "radar_episode".

schema_version.description: Schema contract version this document conforms to (currently pinned to 1.0.0).

public_proxy_id.description: Slug identifying the public proxy this radar episode is derived from (lowercase, dot/underscore/hyphen separated).

provenance.description: Provenance envelope: source kind, source references, generator, timestamp, and payload fingerprint.

license.description: License envelope (SPDX id and optional notice) governing use of this document.

validation.description: Validation envelope: tier, overall status, uncertainty score, and per-check results.

episode_name.description: Human-readable name of the episode (e.g. "intersection_run_007"); non-empty string.

scenario_id.description: Deterministic id of the scenario document this episode was produced from.

sample_rate_hz.description: Complex baseband sampling rate in hertz (Hz) used to produce the episode products; must be strictly positive.

product_paths.description: Relative paths (from the episode root) to product artifacts such as range_doppler, iq, detections, tracks; at least one entry required.
